topic: phone number as an image vs a tap to call tel link
hook: Your phone number is a picture on your website? Nobody can tap it. Fix this tonight.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll check your site and send you the 3 fixes I'd make first. Free.

Picture a homeowner in Ohio at 10 PM with water coming through the ceiling, phone in one hand and a bucket in the other, finding your site on her iPhone. She taps the number in your banner. Nothing.

It's a picture.

Google's own image guidelines say to keep important text out of images. The fix is 1 line of HTML. A tel link, real text, she taps it and the phone dials. Roofers, HVAC, plumbers in Tampa or Tucson, anyone who wants calls.
